subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What public Plugin SDK correlation contract should OpenClaw expose for trace identity across agent, message, compaction, and subagent hooks?
rationale: The remaining work changes public plugin API semantics and privacy boundaries across several hook families, so automation cannot safely choose field names, hook ownership, or rollout order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow additive contract
options.body: Add a single documented correlation shape, reuse DiagnosticTraceContext where possible, and land compatibility-preserving slices across the affected hooks.

options.title: Split by canonical issues
options.body: Keep #50291 as the umbrella but require #80551, #18571, and #80806 to settle their narrower API slices first.

options.title: Limit to existing contexts
options.body: Decline first-class aliases and require plugins to use current ctx.runId, ctx.trace, and sessionKey despite incomplete outbound and subagent run correlation.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow additive contract
recommendation.body: Add a single documented correlation shape, reuse DiagnosticTraceContext where possible, and land compatibility-preserving slices across the affected hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a broad Plugin SDK direction choice and steipete is the best available routing owner from current repository policy and recent central-source history.
